title: Path of the Recording and Skip Machine
statement: Let $k,n$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, and let $d$ be a configuration of the recording machine with $k+2$ work tapes and Boolean symbols. Let $b$ assign a bit to each of the $4k+4$ record positions, and let $s$ be either an index in $\\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ or absent. Suppose $d$ is in the recording machine's initial state, its table tape contains $b(i)$ at the cell offset by $i$ from its head for each record position $i$, and the cells immediately following the record contain the bit serialization of $s$. For every natural number $u\le 4k+5+|\operatorname{optStateBits}(s)|$, after $u$ steps of the recording-and-skip machine the input-head position, all work-tape contents, and output are unchanged; each work-tape head has moved by $\min(u,4k+4)+\max(u-(4k+5),0)$ on the table tape and by zero on every other tape. If $u<4k+5+|\operatorname{optStateBits}(s)|$, the machine is not in the tagged successor phase with either done value.
